knowledge.insight: Jump height must be calculated from takeoff velocity (v²/2g), not flight time — flight time overstates height due to asymmetric take-off/landing posture.

Always bound velocity searches to physiologically meaningful time windows. The global velocity minimum in a CMJ occurs at landing (flight phase), not at end-of-unweighting — an unbounded argmin will misidentify the phase.
COM velocity is derived via impulse-momentum integration: v(t) = ∫ (F_net / m) dt  where F_net = GRF − BW. This is the industry gold standard for force-plate analysis.

AI performance intelligence systems that feed high-stakes decisions (return-to-play, injury risk) require a rule-based contingency engine because AI models can hallucinate phase boundaries on atypical curves.
A confidence gate alone is insufficient for AI safety. Sanity guards (physiological hard limits) must also pass independently — a model can be highly confident about a physically impossible output.
CMJ landing consists of three distinct sub-phases: Loading (contact → peak GRF), Attenuation (peak GRF → local min), Control (local min → COM velocity = 0). mRSI and LPI are control-phase metrics.
A 10 ms Gaussian smoothing kernel (sigma = fs × 0.01) removes force-plate noise without distorting phase boundaries for typical CMJ analysis at 500–2000 Hz.

All automated decisions must be appended to an audit log (JSONL) with: audit_id, timestamp, source (ai/backup/flagged), confidence, sanity_flags, metrics. This is non-negotiable for athlete health systems.

skills.name: cmj_phase_detection
skills.description: Rule-based detection of all 7 CMJ phases (quiet → landing) using velocity zero-crossings, GRF landmarks, and bounded search windows.

skills.name: physiological_sanity_validation
skills.description: Validate AI/model outputs against hard physiological limits (peak GRF, flight time, jump height, landing forces, phase durations).

skills.name: confidence_gated_routing
skills.description: Route analysis requests between AI and rule-based engines using confidence threshold + sanity guard dual-gate logic.

skills.name: impulse_momentum_integration
skills.description: Derive COM velocity from raw GRF using cumulative trapezoidal integration of net force divided by mass (scipy.integrate.cumulative_trapezoid).

skills.name: cmj_visualization
skills.description: Generate publication-quality phase-shaded CMJ force-time curve plots with dual-axis COM velocity overlays and annotated metric boxes.

skills.name: audit_logging
skills.description: Append-only JSONL audit logging for all automated decisions in high-stakes AI systems — includes source, confidence, flags, and metrics.

agents.name: CMJBackupBrain
agents.purpose: Rule-based contingency engine for the AI-driven performance intelligence system. Activates when AI confidence drops below 0.72 or sanity checks fail.
